risk: The baseline may become inaccurate after a new release
cause: Rev 1 and later scorecards can supersede current assumptions
trigger: Any new revision or scorecard is published
response: Run a two-business-day change review and re-baseline affected tasks

risk: CAD configuration control may not be ready
cause: Teamcenter access or university IT approval may be delayed
effect: CAD readiness and later integration work could lose traceability
trigger: No confirmed platform and access path by 2026-09-11
response: Use a documented controlled fallback with named custodian approvals and release archive

risk: Battery analysis may wait on complete source data
cause: Sponsored cell or vehicle specifications may arrive late
effect: Battery targets and architecture modeling could compress
trigger: Required input is unavailable at the planned analysis start
response: Define placeholders source log and work that can proceed independently; escalate missing inputs

risk: Required leadership roles may remain unfilled
effect: Work can become ownerless or overloaded
trigger: Any required role is still open on 2026-09-14
response: Name interim owners backups and recruiting actions before the formal deadline

risk: EcoCAR work may collide with Senior Design and coursework
cause: Shared students have competing milestones and unclear boundaries
effect: Priority work may stall or be duplicated
trigger: Two priority tasks overlap an academic milestone for one owner
response: Publish approved boundaries capture conflicts and cap priority WIP at two items per person

risk: Consistent new members may stop attending before they own anything
cause: Members show interest at meetings but are not given a bounded task, a mentor or a visible result
effect: Sub-teams lose capacity before the spring architecture work and leads spend time re-training replacements
trigger: A regular attendee misses two Friday meetings in a row, or has no claimed task two weeks after joining
response: Offer every consistent member a claimable starter task with a named mentor; show finished work at the Friday meeting; the mentor checks in with anyone who goes quiet

risk: The added hardware may exceed the curb-weight allowance
cause: The rear drive unit, pack, enclosure, cooling, wiring and instrumentation all draw on one weight allowance
effect: An architecture that works on paper fails the maximum curb weight requirement
trigger: The mass budget has rows without a source or an owner, or its total approaches the allowance
response: Keep one mass budget with a sourced number and a named owner on every row; review it at every architecture decision

risk: Graded deliverables stack up between mid-October and mid-November
cause: CAD readiness, off-road targets, the controls tool check, the Year 1 workplan and battery targets all fall within five weeks
effect: Internal review gates get skipped and the same leads are overloaded
trigger: Any deliverable misses its content-complete gate
response: Hold the internal gates; no lead owns two graded deliverables inside three weeks; reassign early when a gate slips

risk: A workstream may depend on one person
cause: Several work packages have a single owner and no named backup
effect: An absence or an exam week stops the work
trigger: An owner cannot report at two meetings in a row
response: Name a backup for every single-owner workstream; the backup's first task is to reproduce the owner's last result

risk: High-voltage work may start before its procedures and coordinator exist
cause: The Facilities and Safety Coordinator role is open and written procedures are required for each high-voltage activity
effect: Work is stopped, or unsafe work goes ahead
trigger: Any plan to handle a battery string above 50 V without an approved permit and a written procedure
response: Fill the coordinator role; allow no energized work above 50 V without a permit, qualified people and a written procedure; keep new-member tasks to analysis and modelling

risk: Know-how may leave with graduating leads
cause: Setup steps and decisions live in individual heads and chat threads
effect: Next year's team relearns the tools and repeats settled decisions
trigger: A lead starts their final semester with no written handoff for their seat
response: Keep the onboarding guides and this hub current; keep each seat's responsibilities on the organization chart; write a handoff note for every seat
